entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Toshiko Tamura  was an early modern feminist novelist who wrote during the late Meiji era, Taishō era, and early Shōwa era. She wrote under the pen-names Roei (露英), Child Bird, Toshiko Suzuki, Yukari, Jun-Sheng (俊生), and Zuo Jun-zhi (佐俊芝), as well as under her maiden name Toshiko Satō and her married name Toshiko Tamura, by which she is best known. Her birth name was Toshi Satō .
